info.name: Digital Signage
info.summary: Display selectable calendars, weather and media widgets on public screens
info.description:
Transform Nextcloud into a professional digital signage solution
Display calendar events with optional descriptions, weather information and media slideshows (images and videos) on public screens without requiring login. Choose the visible widgets independently for each display preset and let the layout adapt automatically. Perfect for offices, schools, shared spaces and reception areas.
**Key Features:**
- **Calendar Integration** – Display upcoming events from multiple Nextcloud calendars - **Event Descriptions** – Optionally show sanitized calendar descriptions below events, limited to three lines - **Media Slideshows** – Automated playback of images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and videos (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV) from Nextcloud folders - **Media Refresh Interval** – Configure how often displays check media folders for changes, in minutes - **Video Support** – Native HTML5 video playback with muted autoplay and automatic transitions - **Weather Information** – Real-time weather data and icons from Nextcloud Weather Status - **Customizable Appearance** – Configure layout, colors and font sizes per text class - **Preset System** – Switch media folders, crop modes, intervals, display settings and visible widgets remotely - **Widget Selection** – Enable or disable the slideshow, weather and calendar independently per preset - **Smart Event Filtering** – Hide specific events with autocomplete-enabled exclusion - **Multi-Display Support** – Manage multiple displays with separate tokens and preset assignments - **Remote Control** – Change presets through the control API without UI access - **Public Access** – Dedicated view tokens for displays without login requirement - **Multi-Language** – Available in English, German (formal/informal), French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian
**Perfect for:** Reception screens, meeting room displays, office dashboards, school information boards, team calendars, shared workspace displays.
info.author: Lukas Märtin
